title: Deliver one activity: commit, progress, closure
description: Use when implementing, fixing or closing one LPM activity (atividade): commit with the LPM-Activity trailer, comment progress and close it. Not for connecting an agent (use lpm-start).
doneWhen: The code is committed with the trailer, progress is commented and the activity is done.
authorityCeiling: Reads, comments and status moves are [A]; API keys are [C]; budgets are [O].
jobs: conclua a atividade e registre o progresso
finish the activity and set its due date
